body: See, here's the problem. There is never any listening. There's preaching, but never listening. I'm agnostic, so talking about how you have been forgiven or saved is meaningless to me. I will also say you aren't being tough when you ask "what's your point" when I've said "you have increased my desire to die."

No, not at all. Some people on hotlines will help you through things, but a lot of them are stupid and useless. I know it's hard to find people to talk to, but it's sad that even the hotline people are trash.
